If we are concerned about performance, this piece will be triggered only when `vpd-tool -w` is executed, and iterating through list of inherited FRUs for a given EEPROM path will not take more than a second.

Is there a compulsion to use std::for_each? Why we can't use a for loop?

> if we are concerned about performance, this piece will be triggered only when vpd-tool -w is executed, and iterating through list of inherited FRUs for a given EEPROM path will not take more than a second.
